text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp ends. Having been 
retrained by Mejiro McQueen, Mejiro 
Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Po～wer～ed up! Look, everyone, I have 
become this strong～.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' good, Bright! Yeah, keep it up, 
you're looking shredded!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, to think you'd grow this sturdy in 
just one summer~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Good grief, why must you be so 
overprotective...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Still, it is rather curious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright's—rapid transformation, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bright worked diligently this summer to 
build up her stamina. And as a result...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My cardiopulmonary endurance has improved, 
granting me a body capable of withstanding 
long distances.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was certain she was better suited for 
medium distance like Ryan, but it seems 
she has an aptitude for long distance as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Are you wondering about how your body is 
changing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, what I find curious is 
the change of “heart.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you adapt your body for long 
distances, the breathing and tactics of a 
stayer are not easily acquired."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, as soon as Bright's body matured, 
she quickly adapted to long-distance 
races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As though they had been a stayer from the 
very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, if you were to describe Bright's 
personality in a single word... what would 
it be?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She takes her time with everything 
she does. And yet, she mastered the knack 
of long-distance running at a terrifying 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It was as if over the course of this one 
summer, what was inside our hearts—swapped 
between Ryan and me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Me passing it to McQueen...? Could 
something like that really happen?
choice_data_list: True, that is odd, isn't it...

text_block_list.text:
I haven't given Mejiro Bright any training 
for long-distance races up until now 
either. If that's the case...

Just what on earth happened? Could it be 
that the aptitudes of the Umamusume 
bearing the Mejiro name were passed down 
to Mejiro Bright...?

A family's talent being passed down 
through generations... Could such an 
almost mystical story really be true...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Is something the matter~?
choice_data_list:
No, it's nothing. Let's give it our all in 
the Kikuka Sho.

No, never mind. Let's do our best in the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeees, of course~.

The mystery remains. Perhaps somewhere 
down the line, something will become clear 
in a race.
